Name: Jello Mod
Author: BubsCC
Description:
This silly mod adds several variations of the Jello bundt cake you can find at the Flower Dance festival. All variations even keep the wiggly Jello animation :3

Includes .PDN (Paint.net) and .PSD (Photoshop) files for creating your own color variations.

[img]https://imgur.com/wbcePe5.gif[/img]

[b][size=5]INSTRUCTIONS[/size][/b]
Extract the JelloMod folder into you mods folder (most often located at [b][i]"[/i][/b][b][i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods"[/i][/b])

Open config.json in a text editor

replace "[b][i]Rainbow[/i][/b]" with the color of your choice:

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]Requires SMAPI 4.3.2+ and Content Patcher 2.8.1+. This mod should be compatible with any texture mod so long as they don't rearrange the objects on the table.
